name: Change in mobile no & Email id

actions.description: IB blocked SMS to the old mobile number
IB blocked SMS to the new mobile number
IB blocked Email to the old email id
IB blocked Email to the new email id
Transfer the call to a live agent

notes: No wait/review timer in this workflow - everything fires immediately and the case is handed to a live agent.
If IRNS itself fails to perform the initial block due to EOD/service unavailability, route to COS_IRNS_IBBLOCK_QUEUE for manual handling instead of IRNS_IBBlock, and notify the Alert system.
